sections.text: 1 Δελεμῖται sunt incolae regionis Dêlam vicinae montibus Gilân. Cf. Pauly-Wissowa, Realc., s. v. μαροῦν B. Est Margiana Graecorum (Marghu, Mouru, hodie Merw.). 3 βαραμάνων A. 4 * Scribendum est Ῥαῖ i. e. Ragai (Ῥάγαι) metropolis in cuius locum successit urbs regia Teherân, quae paulo ab ea distat „. [Th. N.] Ἀμόλ est Amol prope mare Caspium. Vocabulum persicum adamussim ex antiquo nomine Ἀμάρδοι ortum est „. [Th. N.] 5 σπάχες A. * Depravatio nominis Spâhân, Ispâhân „. [Th. N.] χα(σ)άς B : χασάς (οι vel ορ super α) A. * Hoc verbum corruptum esse videtur ex nomine Χουσαστᾶν vel Χουζαστᾶν i. e. regio Chûz sive Susiana „. [Th. N.] 6 κοῦφαι B : κοῦφε A. * Id est Kûfa metropolis quam Arabes non longe ab antiqua Babylone condiderunt et quae post pauca saecula conlapsa est „. [Th. N.] 7 Iberia nota est. * Pro Ἀβασβάν, l. Ἀβασγάν seu Ἀβασκάν i. e. terra Abasgorum (Ἀβασγοί), qui Caucasum incolebant „. [Th. N.] Cf. Pauly-Wissowa, Realenc., s. v. 8 A(ngelicanus) f. 15v. 9 ἐκ A : ἀπὸ B. 10 τοιουτότροπ(ον) B. 11 ζώδιον B : ζῶον A. 14 ζῶα A. 16 παύβεται B. ῥωπί B. 18 A(ngelicanus) f. 58v. οἴων B : omis. sections.en: 1 Delemites are inhabitants of the region of Dêlam neighboring the mountains of Gilân. Cf. Pauly-Wissowa, Realc., s. v. μαροῦν B. It is Margiana of the Greeks (Marghu, Mouru, today Merw.). 3 βαραμάνων A. 4 * It should be written Ῥαῖ i. e. Ragai (Ῥάγαι) metropolis in whose place succeeded the royal city Teherân, which is a little distant from it „. [Th. N.] Ἀμόλ is Amol near the Caspian sea. The Persian word exactly arose from the ancient name Ἀμάρδοι „. [Th. N.] 5 σπάχες A. * Corruption of the name Spâhân, Ispâhân „. [Th. N.] χα(σ)άς B : χασάς (οι or ορ above α) A. * This word seems to be corrupted from the name Χουσαστᾶν or Χουζαστᾶν i. e. the region of Chûz or Susiana „. [Th. N.] 6 κοῦφαι B : κοῦφε A. * That is Kûfa metropolis which the Arabs founded not far from ancient Babylon and which after a few centuries collapsed „. [Th. N.] 7 Iberia is known. * For Ἀβασβάν, read Ἀβασγάν or Ἀβασκάν i. e. the land of the Abasgi (Ἀβασγοί), who inhabited the Caucasus „. [Th. N.] Cf. Pauly-Wissowa, Realenc., s. v. 8 A(ngelicanus) f. 15v. 9 ἐκ A : ἀπὸ B. 10 τοιουτότροπ(ον) B. 11 ζώδιον B : ζῶον A. 14 ζῶα A. 16 παύβεται B. ῥωπί B. 18 A(ngelicanus) f. 58v. οἴων B : omitted A. ταυλίου codd. 19 ταυλί(ον) A : ταυλία B. ἴδε A : ἤδε B. ἐν omitted B. 21 νότος B. 22 τὸ βορά.

summary.headline: Astrological Regions and Games
summary.text: Astrological assignments link zodiac signs and planets with eastern regions including Marroun, Persis, Caramania, Rhe, Amol, Spachais, Chasas, Kouphai, Iberia, and Abasban. The text explains the four elemental qualities, their correspondence with the angles and humors, and gives lunar astrological rules for playing chess or backgammon.
